title: Qwen3.5-2B via Ollama on 8 GB Macs, 8 GB GPUs and 16 GB CPU laptops
slug_note: One command, a 2.7 GB pull: the smallest lane that fits every laptop tier in the directory, including 8 GB Macs.

variation.quant_detail: qwen3.5:2b (llamacpp variant) = 1.88B Q8_0 model (2.0 GB) + 331M BF16 clip projector (671 MB), 2.7 GB total per the tag's details page

engine.config: Ollama default run of the qwen3.5:2b tag; llama.cpp engine underneath, Metal on Apple Silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, CPU on machines with none.

requirements.notes: Estimate: 2.7 GB tag plus headroom for a short context. Fits the 5.3 GB Metal budget of an 8 GB Mac with room to spare; on a 16 GB CPU-only laptop (about 8 GB usable) it is the comfortable size.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: No laptop measurement recorded: status untested. The same command ran as written on our DGX Spark on 2026-11-16; that box's speeds do not carry over to these tiers.
The Ollama tag ships the BF16 vision projector and keeps the text weights at Q8_0 — heavier than a Q4 build of the same size, so on an 8 GB machine close other apps first.

sources.note: tag page: ollama run qwen3.5:2b, 2.7 GB llamacpp variant (1.88B Q8_0 model + 331M BF16 projector), 256K context, Text+Image input, Apache-2.0 license file
base weights card: 2B params, 262,144-token native context, Apache-2.0
